subject.title: [Bug]: Regression: User-configured heartbeat prompt no longer respected

question: Should maintainers refresh the open conflicting fork PR for this heartbeat prompt regression, or close/supersede it and permit a new narrow same-repo repair?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible on current main, but this issue is already paired with an open closing-syntax fork PR and labels that discourage another automatic fix PR until maintainers choose the implementation path.

options.title: Replace With Narrow Same-Repo Repair
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path and sponsor a focused fix with tests for custom prompt preservation and transcript-marker model visibility.

options.title: Refresh The Fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author or an owner to rebase it, add proof, and expand coverage before treating it as the canonical fix.

options.title: Pause For Owner Triage
options.body: Keep this issue open without new repair work until the heartbeat prompt-boundary owner decides the exact fix shape.

recommendation.title: Replace With Narrow Same-Repo Repair
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path and sponsor a focused fix with tests for custom prompt preservation and transcript-marker model visibility.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the path-hint introduction and the first same-repo fix attempt for this regression.
